name: Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas, S.A.
summary: Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides environmental services in Europe and internationally. It operates through Environmental Services; Integrated Water Management; Construction; Concessions; Cement; and Real Estate segments. The company offers municipal services, including waste collection, ground maintenance, beach and costal water cleaning, and maintenance of sewage systems; waste treatment and resource recycling and waste to energy; and facility management, such as cleaning and maintenance of building, fountain, urban furniture, and children's playgrounds, events management, and consultancy and engineering services. It also provides water services comprising catchment, drinking water treatment, distribution, and sanitation; concessions through BOT contracts; exploitation of hydraulic infrastructures; and EPC design and construction projects; and infrastructure services, which include construction of bridges, roads, tunnels, subway, railway, airport, maritime, and hydraulic works; and construction and maintenance of infrastructures, electromechanical installations, electricity distribution networks, and oil and gas pipeline, as well as buildings. In addition, the company engages in the financing, management, and operation of transport and social infrastructure concessions; production and marketing of cement, concrete, aggregate, and mortar. Further, it is involved in housing rental projects; leasing and management of office buildings, commercial premises, and shopping centres; urban land management; and promotion and sale of real estate products. The company was formerly known as Fomento de Obras y Construcciones S.A. and changed its name to Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas, S.A. in January 1992. Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas, S.A. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain. The company operates as a subsidiary of Control Empresarial de Capitales SA de CV.
